research_decision: Use this versioned context dataset to design a new bounded training-only experiment. Do not resume the rejected snapshot adapter or claim a strategy improvement from feature availability.
summary: Joined genuine sequential past-only observations from 112 training sessions to the unchanged eligible sixty-second decision cases. Every dense observation contributes regardless of eligibility or future target availability. All 19,678 supervised examples passed local tokenizer-only preflight; no model weights, inference, fitting or trading.

data.scope: Only train-role processed row/case files and original train.jsonl; original manifest and research-report metadata revalidated. No raw archive replay, validation/test row files, reserved outcomes or broker/cloud/BTC changes.
data.exposure: Already-exposed within-training temporal development, not an independent holdout. No 2026 reserved outcome access.
data.target: Unchanged 6E futures crossed-quote opportunity classes after 100ms delayed entry and 15s hold at 1/2/4 extra total round-trip ticks. Not EUR/USD broker CFD fills, portfolio returns or executed trades.
data.unknown_handling: Unavailable and uncertain targets remain a separate ledger with null completion. They never become negative training labels, but their observations still contribute to later causal context.
data.selection_warning: Resolved acceptable cases only supply supervised targets. Retaining unknowns and natural class counts does not remove outcome-selection bias.
data.not_all_historical_data: This step joins the existing training-only decision-window observations; it does not analyze all raw history or expand the original session/window split.

encoding.history_rows: Three [prior count, prior span fraction, ten observation-weighted snapshot means] arrays.
encoding.interval: Completed receive-time observations in [now-lookback,now); current excluded from history until after encoding.
encoding.reset: Fresh state per session/contract; reset on observation gap greater than 5 seconds or causal prior-quote-gap feature greater than 5 seconds.
encoding.missing_history: Explicit zero count/span/means; no interpolation, forward fill or borrowing from another session.
encoding.precision: Finite eight-significant-digit encoding, integer sample counts preserved. No sequence truncation.
encoding.limitations: Means of 5-second CVD/OFI snapshots are not longer-window raw volume sums. Replenishment and absorption inputs are observable proxies, not confirmed iceberg labels or causal explanations.
encoding.versioning: Separate schema and task incompatible with existing v1 snapshot runners and adapters; this dataset alone does not add v2 training or inference support.

verification.source_files: Every consumed dense row and eligible case file verified against original pinned SHA256 and counts at read and rehashed before completion.
verification.case_cohort: Every eligible sparse case must equal the original causally thinned dense row after removing case-only path_horizons; no successful subset.
verification.causal_prefix: Each case bound to newline-canonical causal fields only through the current decision; full source SHA256 and original case/record pins retained separately.
verification.context_observer_future_access: Observer receives only session/contract/partition/time/features/execution_features, never eligibility, outcome, path, target or hindsight fields.
verification.independent_check_semantics: Direct prior-window summation, count/span and prefix hashing independently checked every supervised case on these two sessions, including unfiltered ineligible observations; finite means tolerance 1e-7 relative / 1e-8 absolute.
verification.failure_behavior: New exclusive outputs only; retain failure evidence without completion receipt, subset acceptance, output reuse or automatic retries.

token_preflight.environment: .venv-qwen-train, Python 3.12.10, local tokenizers 0.23.2; historical builder ran in original CPU .venv
token_preflight.decoder_dependency_fix: A separate pure token-preflight module can inspect the completed pinned dataset without databento_dbn, torch, transformers or peft imports. Only the explicitly requested local tokenizer is loaded.
token_preflight.receipt_distinction: Token preflight records the preparation source pin and revalidates the lightweight token-pipeline code pin. It does not import or re-execute the historical preparation pipeline; that stronger check was done separately in the CPU environment.

next_separately_bounded_step.development: Add a new versioned context-v2 training recipe/worker and pre-register a representative-prior inner-fit curriculum, comparison controls and full inner-check evaluation before fitting.
next_separately_bounded_step.sampling: Preserve natural fit class proportions and include no-opportunity cases. No check examples in fitting and no repeat of the rejected uniformly balanced 224-example snapshot experiment.
next_separately_bounded_step.starting_model: Use the unchanged approved local base checkpoint; do not resume or promote the rejected adapter.
next_separately_bounded_step.gates: Run a bounded offline research fit only after the v2 runner and all safety gates pass tests. No automatic GPU training from dataset preparation, no check-driven threshold tuning, no reserved evaluation or deployment.
next_separately_bounded_step.evaluation: Report wrong-side/no-opportunity directional errors, missed opportunities, activity, per-session support and abstention alongside accuracy. Improved context availability is not strategy validation or proof of profitability.
next_separately_bounded_step.execution: EUR/USD CFD trading still requires broker-specific cost/fill evidence and paper/risk validation; 6E futures labels are auxiliary research signals.
